primary_evaluation: IDQS (RTP-QoS + PDM) LDoS detection on CIC-IDS2017 Wednesday traffic (Slowloris, Slowhttptest); abstract reports 91% accuracy
Q1_lookback: time step tau = 50 s (uses flows k and k-tau); PDM uses T past timeslots, T unstated
Q1_quote: predicts the QoS for the future traffic flow k + τ ... based on the collection of current and the past network traffic flow features
Q2_quote: Since IDQS is specifically designed for the continuous time-series analysis of low-rate attacks, our experiments focus exclusively on the traffic recorded on Wednesday.
Q4_quote: for τ = 200 s, the first 200 seconds –approximately 5%– of the data are used solely for providing model inputs
notes: Dataset coded by search (CIC-IDS2017); abstract names SDN-SlowRate-DDoS first. Features: avg packets/s, bytes/packet, flows/s, flow life, plus recurrent rTPNN over consecutive flows. Q2: recurrent per-flow model processes flows in order; CIC-IDS2017 split/order not otherwise stated. Q3: paper gives attack times (Slowloris 9:47-10:10, Slowhttptest 10:14-10:35) but not the stream start/extent used, so benign-precedes-attack not stated for CIC-IDS2017; on SDN-SlowRate-DDoS Q3 would be YES (Fig 4 'Before Attack', 'During Attack', 'After Attack' phases per experiment). Q4 passage is from the SDN QoS-prediction analysis; Sec 4.4 says CIC eval uses same tau = 50 ('only 2.5% for τ = 50 s'); Conclusion also: 'requires an initial window of historical data before it can generate its first reliable prediction'. PDM T-slot history warm-up not stated. Q5 NA: single Wednesday capture.

notes: Detector is per-sample MLP encoder + expert heads ('For a sample xi, the model produces embedding zi and class probabilities pi', Sec 3.2).
